title: Topic 3
japanese_text: 返品の際は、返品専用<u>ラベル</u>を貼り、指定の<u>返送</u>先へお送りください。未<u>開封</u>の場合、全額<u>返金</u>します。<u>パッケージ</u>を開封済みの場合、商品代金の60%を返金します。
english_translation: To return an item, please attach a return label and send it to the designated return address. If the package is unopened, you will receive a full refund. If the package has been opened, 60% of the product price will be refunded.
